verses.1: To David, the LORD says: “I will call upon my covenant. Do not be afraid of me, for I will not harm you. I will not punish you along with your descendants.”
verses.2: Hear the sound of my cries in your presence. I raise my hands towards your holy place.
verses.3: Do not dwell with sinners. Do not speak kind words to those who do evil deeds. Have evil thoughts in their hearts.
verses.4: Give them what they deserve, and treat them as they should be. Let them have their own place to live in.
verses.5: For they will not understand the deeds of Jehovah, nor the works of His hands. They will not be able to build anything.
verses.6: Blessed is Jehovah, who has heard the cry of my prayer.
verses.7: Yehova, you are strong and mighty. I trust in you completely; I will rely on you. You will bless my heart, and I will sing praises to you.
verses.8: Yehova, grant him strength and deliver him from his troubles. His Messiah is indeed a savior.
verses.9: He will save your people, and bless your land. Then there will be peace and prosperity throughout the world.
